en.summary: Memory demand and profitability surged, with strong quarterly cash generation. Fiscal Q4 includes an extra week, affecting sequential comparability.
findings: FY2026 Q4 revenue was $54.229B versus $41.456B last quarter and $11.315B a year ago. The quarter ended September 3, following May 28.
GAAP gross margin was 86.8% and diluted EPS was $32.87. These reported outcomes should not be extrapolated as a permanent memory-cycle margin.
Quarterly operating cash flow was $43.97B; company-adjusted free cash flow was $33.20B after net capital investment. This differs from gross property-purchase cash flow.

follow_ups.question: Will growth sustain earnings and cash returns after investment?
follow_ups.update: Monitor demand, expenses, working capital and cash capital purchases.
follow_ups.next_check: Next quarterly disclosure and official supplemental materials.

limitations: A research snapshot of the listed official materials. Official earnings-call text was not collected.
Standalone and cumulative periods are treated separately; cash flows may require adjacent cumulative-period subtraction. Missing values are not zero.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was retained. Unverified numerical guidance is omitted from the guidance table.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.

metrics.label: Adjusted free cash flow (company)
metrics.definition: Company OCF less property purchases plus property sales and government incentives; differs from gross cash purchases.
